strategies.name: Strategy 1
strategies.title: HTF Bias · 15M
strategies.summary: Daily + H4 trend agree (close vs EMA50, EMA20 vs EMA50). Enters on a fresh M15 close through the previous-day high/low in the London (10:00–14:00 EAT) or NY (15:30–20:00 EAT) window. Stop 1.0 × H4 ATR; exits on the first H4 close back across the H4 EMA20 or after 10 days. Max 1 trade a day.

strategies.name: Strategy 2
strategies.title: VWAP Fade · 5M
strategies.summary: On range days (not all six 10:00–10:30 EAT closes on one side of VWAP), fades a poke of the 2.0σ VWAP band once an M5 candle closes back inside, 10:00–12:00 EAT. Stop beyond the poke extreme + 1.0 × H1 ATR; target 2R; flat at 17:00 EAT. Max 3 a day, stops for the day after −2R.

strategies.name: Strategy C
strategies.title: Breakout · ATR Trail
strategies.summary: Same Daily + H4 bias. Enters on a fresh M15 close through the previous-day high/low or the Asian range (03:00–10:00 EAT) in the London/NY windows. Stop 0.75 × H4 ATR; after +1R a 3 × ATR trailing stop; 10-day time stop. Max 3 a day; positions can overlap.
